title: SPREAD SPURIOUS ATTRIBUTE: IMPROVING WORST-GROUP ACCURACY with SPURIOUS ATTRIBUTE ESTIMATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group classification accuracy on the CelebA dataset (where gender is spuriously correlated with hair color) and the CivilComments-WILDS dataset (toxicity classification of text mentioning male/female demographic identities).
Evaluating worst-group classification accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset for toxicity classification of text mentioning racial identities (White, Black).
Evaluating worst-group classification accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset for toxicity classification of text mentioning LGBTQ identities.
Evaluating worst-group classification accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset for toxicity classification of text mentioning religious identities (Muslim, Christian, other religion).
